correctness_confidence.basis: Verified 18 core theorems in Lean 4.35.0 with zero sorry, zero warnings, and exact-rational verification via DELEG-DC-CERT-1.0 covering all algebraic, knapsack, Bernstein positivity, and profile inequalities.

novelty.basis: First complete zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization and exact-rational certificate auditor for combinatorial downward-closed delegation bounds.

reproducibility.basis: Accompanied by standalone Lean 4 code, pure-stdlib Python exact rational verifier, 16 canonical certificates, and automated test suite.

rigor.basis: Exhaustive formal verification with zero floating-point arithmetic, strict input sanitization, and 60/60 adversarial red-team rejections.

significance.basis: Establishes rock-solid machine-checked foundations and exact rational certificates for recent breakthroughs in delegated choice under downward-closed feasibility constraints.

strengths: Pioneering zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization of 18 core delegation theorems with zero sorry
Pure-stdlib exact-rational auditor DELEG-DC-CERT-1.0 avoiding all floating-point arithmetic
Rigorous red-team validation with 60/60 adversarial forgery rejections
strong_novelty_candidates: Complete formal mechanization of combinatorial delegated choice bounds and Bernstein positivity in Lean 4
summary: The paper presents a rigorous, zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization and exact-rational certificate auditor verifying Abdi et al.'s improved downward-closed delegation bounds. With 18 zero-sorry theorems, exact degree-7 Bernstein positivity evaluations, and 60/60 red-team rejections, it achieves exceptional verification rigor.
weaknesses: Scope excludes measure-theoretic martingale proofs and Appendix A dynamic program inside Lean 4, relying on cited external literature for asymptotic foundations.
